notes: §1985:VI.6.25.2 prints STRING, groups of identifier-1/literal-1 each closed by DELIMITED BY identifier-2, literal-2 or SIZE, then INTO identifier-3, '[WITH POINTER identifier-4]', '[ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1]', '[NOT ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-2 ]' and END-STRING in that sequence. stringStatement holds the group/INTO/POINTER order, BindString binds the groups, VisitStringStatement refuses the 2002 omission of DELIMITED before INTO (COBOL0900), and VisitConditionalPhrases via ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder (kb/Work PB5158) now refuses NOT ON OVERFLOW before ON OVERFLOW at --std 85 (COBOL0900), closing the prior PARTIAL. Probed at 85: reversed phrases, no DELIMITED and last DELIMITED omitted, POINTER twice, POINTER before INTO, no sending operand, ON OVERFLOW twice, two INTO operands, ALL literals, numeric literal sender and ref-modified INTO all refused; two groups with POINTER (ABCDEXYZ, P=9, NOT ON OVERFLOW), figurative QUOTE/ZERO/SPACE senders, ODO and ref-mod senders, numeric integer sender, overflow mid-transfer (P=9) and pointer 0 (R unchanged) all as the text requires. The witness runs two groups, POINTER and both phrases in the printed order. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-08.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-08-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "{identifier-1|literal-1} … DELIMITED BY {identifier-2|literal-2|SIZE} … [ON OVERFLOW …] [NOT ON OVERFLOW …]"; 2023: "The DELIMITED phrase may be omitted only immediately preceding the INTO phrase. If it is omitted, DELIMITED BY SIZE is implied.". 1985 requires DELIMITED BY in every group. 2023 lets the one before INTO be omitted, implying SIZE. Its choice indicators also allow ON OVERFLOW and NOT ON OVERFLOW in either order.
